metaDescription: Build a Content-Security-Policy header from a preset and extra sources, with meta, nginx and Apache output. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Build a Content-Security-Policy from a strict, balanced or lockdown preset plus your own allowed sources. It prints the header, a meta tag, an nginx line and an Apache line.
why:
A Content-Security-Policy is one of the strongest defences against cross-site scripting, but writing one from scratch is fiddly. A single wrong source breaks scripts or fonts, and a policy that is too loose gives a false sense of security.

This builder starts from a preset: strict with nonces and strict-dynamic, balanced with same-origin defaults, or lockdown with everything denied. You add the hosts you really need for scripts, styles, images, fonts, connections, frames and media, set frame-ancestors and an optional report address, and choose whether to send it as Report-Only. The output is ready to paste into server config. Test in report-only mode first, because the tool cannot know what your pages load.
howTo: Choose a preset: strict, balanced or lockdown.
Add extra sources for script, style, image, font, connect, frame and media directives, separated by spaces.
Set frame-ancestors and a report URL if you have one, and tick Report-Only to test first.
Run the tool and copy the header, meta tag, nginx or Apache line.

faq.q: Which preset should I start with?
faq.a: Balanced is the simplest to adopt. Strict gives better protection against injected scripts but needs a fresh nonce on every response. Lockdown denies everything by default and suits static sites.

faq.q: Why should I use Report-Only first?
faq.a: Report-Only logs violations without blocking anything, so you can find sources you forgot before enforcing the policy. Switch it off only when reports are clean.

faq.q: What are the limits of the meta tag version?
faq.a: Meta tags ignore frame-ancestors, report-uri and sandbox, and do not support Report-Only. Use the HTTP header where you can.
No. The policy is built in your browser from the options you choose and nothing is sent anywhere.
